# Medipyxis Help

> Help center for Medipyxis, the wound care EMR and practice management platform for mobile wound care teams.

It guides clinicians through 17 sections — from consent to provider attestation — so the note is complete, meets Medicare LCD documentation needs, and produces bill

## What's new

- [What's new, in video](https://help.medipyxis.com/whats-new/): Short silent videos of recent changes in Medipyxis, each with a description of what is on screen and why it matters.
- [How do Practice Protocols work?](https://help.medipyxis.com/whats-new/practice-protocols/): Practice Protocols let your practice write its own wound-care steps, or adopt one of the optional examples, and show them to clinicians during visits. Your practice's administrators and medical directors choose, write and turn on these protocols. Medipyxis never turns one on. A protocol is guidance only: it doesn't block saving, signing or finishing a visit.
- [How do signed and unsigned visits show on the Timeline and in the PDF?](https://help.medipyxis.com/whats-new/timeline-signoff/): On a patient's Timeline, a locked visit names the clinician who signed it, and its PDF reads Signed by and SIGNED & FINALIZED. An unsigned draft shows Draft and Entered by its author, and its PDF shows PENDING SIGNATURE with no signer.
- [How does a patient import fill in a one-line address?](https://help.medipyxis.com/whats-new/import-address-new/): When a patient file lists the address on one line, the import fills in the street, city, state and ZIP on the new chart, and tidies the ZIP to 62999-0001.
- [What happens when a re-import fills a missing address?](https://help.medipyxis.com/whats-new/import-address-refill/): Re-importing a file for a patient already on file with no address fills in that address, listed under Needs Follow-Up, and changes nothing else. A row whose address differs from the one on file is held for review, and the chart keeps its original address.
- [How does a deceased patient's chart describe the status?](https://help.medipyxis.com/whats-new/deceased-status-copy/): A deceased patient’s chart shows the Deceased status and the note Recorded in error? Use Clear deceased under Appointment messages. The chart no longer says the status can be changed.
- [How are dates checked before a patient import?](https://help.medipyxis.com/whats-new/preflight-dates/): When you review a patient file before importing, dates written as MM/DD/YYYY are read month-first and shown converted. A date that could be read two ways is flagged so you can confirm it.
- [How do I search the Fax Review Queue?](https://help.medipyxis.com/whats-new/fax-queue-search/): Search the Fax Review Queue by patient name or sender fax. With Search all fax text on, a phrase in the subject is found and marked Matched: Subject.
- [How does Use last order fill the MRN?](https://help.medipyxis.com/whats-new/use-last-order-mrn/): Use last order copies the previous order into a new draft. If that order’s ID / MRN was empty, the new form fills the chart MRN.
- [How do I pick a wound from today's visit on an order?](https://help.medipyxis.com/whats-new/order-picker-todays-wounds/): The order wound picker includes wounds from today’s unsigned visit, labelled (new from today’s visit). A chart wound fills its measured size; a new draft wound fills location.
- [How does a new order form get the chart MRN?](https://help.medipyxis.com/whats-new/order-form-mrn-prefill/): A new Wound Care Supplies Order prefills ID / MRN from the chart. The field stays editable. The form is closed without saving.
- [How do I upload my practice's consent form?](https://help.medipyxis.com/whats-new/consent-upload/): Practices can upload their own consent form as a PDF in Administrator Hub, Consent Documentation. The silent video shows choosing a PDF, confirming the practice's own lawyer reviewed it, and uploading it. Practices that have not uploaded a form see no change.
- [Deceased card and filter](https://help.medipyxis.com/whats-new/deceased-filter/): All Patients has a Deceased card. Clicking it lists deceased patients, and the status filter shows Deceased. A deceased chart shows Status: Deceased.
- [How do I record the indication on a debridement pop-up?](https://help.medipyxis.com/whats-new/debridement-indication/): On the Sharp and Enzymatic debridement pop-ups, Indication is now the first field. The silent video shows the Indication list, the sharp choices Slough, Biofilm and Other with free text, and the enzymatic choices Necrotic / devitalized tissue and Eschar.

## Training videos

- [How do I use Medipyxis? Video training, from referral to signed visit](https://help.medipyxis.com/whats-new/medipyxis-training/): Sixteen short training videos covering the daily workflow in Medipyxis from referral intake through visit documentation, plus CRM, HR onboarding, vendor order forms, patient orders, Fleet Calendar, the Oversight Cockpit and Team Chat, each with captions and a full transcript.
